# cycle_clusters (Data Source)

Lists Cycle infrastructure clusters in the hub.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cycle_clusters" "all" {}

output "cluster_identifiers" {
  value = [for cluster in data.cycle_clusters.all.clusters : cluster.identifier]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (Attributes List) The clusters in the hub. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))

<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this cluster belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the cluster.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slugged identifier of the cluster.
- `non_essential` (Boolean) Whether the cluster is marked as non-essential.
- `state` (String) The current state of the cluster.
